description: Optional settings for the standard NonLinLoc adapter.

fields.date: Pick-table reference date in YYYYMMDDHHMM format
fields.native_obs: Boolean; use event.obs rather than picks_simple.txt
fields.prepare_only: Boolean; prepare controls and grids without running NLLoc
fields.location_method: LOCMETH method: EDT_OT_WT (default), EDT (equal differential time) or GAU_ANALYTIC (L2 Gaussian likelihood)
fields.grid_center: Optional {latitude, longitude, depth_km}: build the search grid around this point (+-10 km); default: a grid spanning the station footprint

notes: The velocity model, stations and observations are supplied as input files.
The standard adapter builds a 1-D geometry around grid_center or the station footprint; advanced control generation belongs to Nonlinlocpy. Multi-event catalogs: interface/locate.py.
Native binaries are selected with --bin-dir or the bundled runtime/bin directory.
